//: EXAMPLE ONLY - merge by hand into a project's .claude/settings.json (or ~/.claude/settings.json).
The installer never writes settings. Replace the <placeholders> with the project's real commands.
Merge path: by default the OWNER merges (gh pr merge is NOT allowed). To let agents merge,
move "Bash(gh pr merge:*)" from 'ask' to 'allow' and run /delivery-config mergePath=agent.
env: compaction window for long-running sessions. 300000 suits the orchestrator (/loop /deliver);
ticket workers use ~400000 (set through their launch env if your worktree tool can pass it).
Subagents get autoCompactWindow: 200000 from their own frontmatter (Claude Code 2.1.296+).
Pushing ticket branches and opening draft PRs is allowed because workers do it (the /deliver bootstrap
asks once). Deny rules win over allow rules, so force-pushes stay blocked.
